definitions.explanation: Being so shocked or surprised that one is unable to speak or react.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{唖然|あぜん}とした。
examples.english: I was stunned by the news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧{唖然|あぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone was left speechless by his remark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}{外|がい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{唖然|あぜん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I was so dumbfounded by the unexpected turn of events that I couldn't find any words.

notes:
{唖然|あぜん} describes being so shocked or surprised that one is rendered speechless. The character {唖|あ} relates to being mute — literally struck silent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
As a たる-adjective / ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧-adverb, it primarily appears in these patterns:
- {唖然|あぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be dumbfounded
- {唖然|あぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become speechless
- {唖然|あぜん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: being dumbfounded (adverbial, modifying a following verb)
- {唖然|あぜん}たる⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: a dumbfounded expression (たる modifying a noun)

USAGE:
Usually triggered by something unexpected, outrageous, or hard to believe. Can describe both genuine shock and exasperated disbelief.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧/⟦{呆然|ぼうぜん}→呆然：17758_bouzen⟧: dazed, stunned (more about being mentally blank)
- ⟦{愕然|がくぜん}→愕然：08682_gakuzen⟧: astonished, aghast (stronger shock)
- {唖然|あぜん} specifically emphasizes being unable to speak due to surprise
